entry.title: Fraud Detection with Graph Transformers on Payment Networks
entry.summary: Graph transformers over card payment networks detect fraud rings in banking and insurance with fewer false positives than gradient boosting.

entry.title: Recommendation Models for Grocery Demand under Supply Shocks
entry.summary: We adapt recommendation and demand forecasting models for grocery and food retailers when supply chain shocks change what shoppers can buy.

entry.title: Agent Memory Benchmarks for Long-Horizon Enterprise Tasks
entry.summary: A benchmark for agent memory across week-long enterprise workflows in software operations and customer support.
